basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and tech enthusiast from the Great Lakes region. I spend most of my free time exploring new gaming worlds and tweaking my Android devices. I work in IT support, which keeps me busy during the day, but I unwind by skateboarding and playing games like Fallout 76 and Ori and the Blind Forest. I'm a night owl, often online in the late evenings. Currently single and focused on my career and hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a background in IT, I've developed a solid understanding of technology and gaming hardware. I self-taught myself Android customization and developed a keen interest in exploring different launchers. My gaming knowledge stems from years of playing RPGs and open-world games, with a particular fondness for the Fallout series.
